details: Before resolving a source-colour part request, locate a unique semantic same-part selector among all zones, including muted and pending records; any manual, duplicate, or ambiguous match fails closed.

For the one candidate, require current edit registration, scopedPartProofCurrent and currentPartZoneOwners, exact current committed strong file SHA source binding, matching source generation/path/dimensions, current CAR/layout/mask/layer proof, fully visible footprint, exact zone/part mask match, visible body-paint layer binding, solid paint appearance, and full strength.
Canonicalize the planned selector to the saved owner selector only after proof succeeds, then queue an edit with unchanged base color and attach the fresh proof for downstream validation.
If a same-part prior zone exists but proof is unavailable or stale, refuse without adding a replacement.

remaining.observed: E.plan returns null for “Change the roof finish to gloss without repainting it.” on both baseline and candidate, before owner lookup. Candidate therefore leaves that frozen positive unserved; parser capability was not changed in this ownership lane.
remaining.owner_proof: The edit callback is controlled. The test proves selector resolution, no add-zone, no color field, and proof attached to the edit request; it does not execute actual makeTools/doEdit or an apply.
